The grass is soft and green, and the voles are small and quick. I strike and they are gone. I do not describe. I hunt.

They are the main food, more than any other creature. I also eat mice, shrews, and sometimes a field vole. But voles are the most common. Shrews. They are small, quick, and make a lot of noise. I hear them scurrying through the undergrowth, and I can smell them. They are the first to come in the autumn, and I catch them with a quick dive. I like the way they squeak when I grab them. They are not as big as voles, but they are plentiful. I also like voles, but they are harder to catch. Shrews are my favourite.

I am safe here, and I watch the world from my perch. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.
